Measure: Track, on a comparable sample of handoffs after the change, (a) the proportion of handoffs missing a proof link at submission, and (b) the distribution of handoff durations (days), to see if the missing-link rate and the delay range shrink relative to the 4/10 and 2-6 day baseline.

Missing inputs: The source does not provide labor-cost data, a root-cause breakdown for the other 6 handoffs, sample size/representativeness beyond these ten cases, or any prior approval/decision to implement a mandatory-field gate.
